prompt_text: Where is the best place to get an oil change in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
**SpeeDee Oil Change & Auto Service** looks like a strong all-around choice: it’s at **44 Mission Dr.** and has **125 verified reviews on CARFAX, with 95% rated five stars**. It offers oil changes as well as other maintenance services. [CARFAX reviews](https://www.carfax.com/Reviews-SpeeDee-Oil-Change-and-Auto-Service-Pleasanton-CA_4WKZDJO001)

If you’d rather use a local general repair shop, **Old Town Auto Care** at **57 California Ave., Ste. O** also offers oil changes. I’d call ahead to confirm availability and pricing, and ask whether the quote includes the right oil and filter for your car.
